fields.System.Title: OUT-604 — Generate a manifest
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a shipping clerk, I want a document listing what is on the vehicle, so that the
driver has a record of what they accepted.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a shipment, then the manifest lists every carton with its order reference,
  • weight, and destination.
  • - Given the manifest, then it shows total carton count and total weight.
  • - Given a shipment not yet confirmed, then a draft manifest can be produced and is
  • marked draft.
  • - Given a confirmed shipment, then the manifest is fixed and reflects exactly what was
  • dispatched.
  • - Given the manifest, then it is generated as content — the system does not print it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | shipment, shipment_carton, carton |
| Risks | Manifest regenerated after dispatch showing different content |
| Tests | integration |
